name: in-turn-screen
description: The in-turn learning screen at the published levels (docs/plans/in-turn-learning.md, section 6), on the development half: the 29 new arms, each comma-z0-coarse with one thing changed, played; the reference arms and the AB-EMCTS arms taken from the published runs (reuse), in the R7615's currency extended with the new arms. Exploratory: it chooses what the confirmation tests. What the screen chooses for the confirmation, written before it runs (docs/plans/in-turn-learning.md, section 6): the best learner (comma-z0-mid, -fine, -hier, -linear, -mlp) and the best mutation or self-learning rule (the sixteen mut- mutation rules and the seven mut- self-learning ideas), each judged by the mean, over every level it ran at (the three published levels here, and 30 s in in-turn-30s), of its mean paired difference with comma-z0-coarse, among the arms whose interval against comma-z0-coarse lies above zero at one level or more; where no arm of a group has one, the confirmation keeps comma-z0-coarse's own (the table at coarse keys, or uniform mutation). At most two other arms the screen singles out may join it, each named with the reason. The intervals are read as screening, not as findings.
